description:
A QGIS Project Configurator configuration file.

Any value can be replaced with `!include <path>` to read it from another
YAML file. The path is relative to the including file.

data_sources.title: Data Sources
data_sources.description:
Data sources by name.

The data source to use is selected when creating the project.

product_versions.title: Product Versions
product_versions.description: Product version names. Used to select styles with `style_overrides`.

layer_tree.title: Layer Tree
layer_tree.description: Layers and groups of the project, from top to bottom.

project_properties.description: Values written to the project with `QgsProject.writeEntry`, and the CRS.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.description: Print layouts to add to the project.

title: ProjectConfig

service.title: Service
service.description: Name of the PostgreSQL connection service (pg_service.conf).

table.title: Table
table.description:
Table name for every layer. It replaces the layer's own `table`.

Usually left out or null, and each layer sets its `table`.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path to the .gpkg file, relative to the config file.

table.title: Table
table.description:
Table name for every layer. It replaces the layer's own `table`.

Usually left out or null, and each layer sets its `table`.

LayerTreeNode.description:
A layer tree item.

The key `group`, `vector_layer` or `embedded_group` sets its kind.

GroupNode.description: A layer group in the layer tree.

group.title: Group
group.description: Group name. Groups with no layers left are not added to the project.

children.title: Children
children.description: Layers and groups inside this group.

defaults.description:
Settings for all layers inside this group, also in sub groups.

Merged with the defaults of parent groups. Nested mappings merge,
lists and other values replace. A layer's own settings win.

GroupNode.title: GroupNode

VectorLayerSettings.description: Vector layer settings. Allowed on a layer and in group `defaults`.

style.title: Style
style.description:
Path to a .qml style file, relative to the config file.

Use `hidden` to leave the layer out of the project.

style_overrides.title: Style Overrides
style_overrides.description:
Style per product version: product version name to .qml path or `hidden`.

Wins over `style` when that product version is selected.

table.title: Table
table.description: Table name in the selected data source.

data_source_overrides.title: Data Source Overrides
data_source_overrides.description: Data source settings per data source name. Merged over `data_sources`.

map_themes.title: Map Themes
map_themes.description: Names of the map themes where the layer is visible.

VectorLayerSettings.title: VectorLayerSettings

ScaleConfig.description:
Scale range where the layer is visible.

Values are scale denominators (1000 means 1:1000). Null or 0 means no limit.

min.title: Min
min.description: Most zoomed out scale where the layer is visible (e.g. 3000000).

max.title: Max
max.description: Most zoomed in scale where the layer is visible (e.g. 500000).

ScaleConfig.title: ScaleConfig

DataSourceOverride.description:
Data source settings for one layer or group.

Merged over the data source with the same name in `data_sources`,
so only the changed keys are needed.

service.title: Service
service.description: Name of the PostgreSQL connection service (pg_service.conf).

path.title: Path
path.description: Path to the .gpkg file, relative to the config file.

table.title: Table
table.description: Table name. Wins over the layer's `table`.

DataSourceOverride.title: DataSourceOverride

VectorLayerNode.description: A vector layer in the layer tree.

style.title: Style
style.description:
Path to a .qml style file, relative to the config file.

Use `hidden` to leave the layer out of the project.

style_overrides.title: Style Overrides
style_overrides.description:
Style per product version: product version name to .qml path or `hidden`.

Wins over `style` when that product version is selected.

table.title: Table
table.description: Table name in the selected data source.

data_source_overrides.title: Data Source Overrides
data_source_overrides.description: Data source settings per data source name. Merged over `data_sources`.

map_themes.title: Map Themes
map_themes.description: Names of the map themes where the layer is visible.

VectorLayerNode.title: VectorLayerNode

EmbeddedGroupNode.description: A layer group embedded from another QGIS project.

embedded_group.title: Embedded Group
embedded_group.description: Name of the group in the source project.

source.title: Source
source.description: Path to the source QGIS project, relative to the created project's folder.

EmbeddedGroupNode.title: EmbeddedGroupNode

ProjectProperties.description:
Project properties: the first key is the scope, nested keys form the key path.

Every key other than `crs` is a scope.

crs.title: Crs
crs.description: EPSG code of the project CRS (e.g. 3067). Sets the CRS, not a property.

ProjectProperties.title: ProjectProperties

ProjectPropertyValue.description:
A project property value, or a mapping of nested keys.

Nested keys are joined with `/`: `A: { B: { C: 1 } }` writes key `B/C`
in scope `A`. A value directly under the scope is written to key `/`.

layout_file.title: Layout File
layout_file.description: Path to a .qpt layout template, relative to the config file.

atlas_coverage_layer.title: Atlas Coverage Layer
atlas_coverage_layer.description: Name of the layer to use as the atlas coverage layer.
